### Load in Packages and Data 
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: hide
# Set up

# Load in libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)       # raster handling
library(sf)          # vector handling
library(tmap)


# Load in sea surface data
sst_2008 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif")
sst_2009 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif")
sst_2010 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif")
sst_2011 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif")
sst_2012 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif")


# Load in depth data
depth <- rast("data/depth.tif")


# Load in EEZ data
EEZ <- st_read("data/wc_regions_clean.shp")
```

### Process Data

```{r}
# Combine yearly raster layers into one raster
sst_stack <- c(sst_2008, sst_2009, sst_2010, sst_2011, sst_2012)

# Assign full EPSG code to SST (same system as depth, missing label)
crs(sst_stack) <- "EPSG:4326"

# Transform EEZ to match SST if CRSs differ
if (!same.crs(sst_stack, EEZ)) {
  warning("Transforming EEZ to match SST CRS")
  EEZ <- st_transform(EEZ, crs(sst_stack))
}

```

```{r}
# Process data so layers can be combined 

# find mean SST from 2008-2012
sst_avg <- mean(sst_stack)

# Convert average SST from kelvin to celsius
avg_sst_C <- sst_avg - 273.15

# Crop depth raster to match the extent of the SST raster
depth_crop <- crop(depth, avg_sst_C)

# Resample the depth data to match resolution of SST
depth_resample <- resample(depth_crop, avg_sst_C, method = "bilinear")
```

```{r}
# Verify depth and SST match in CRS, extent, and resolution
if (compareGeom(avg_sst_C, depth_resample, crs = TRUE, ext = TRUE,
                rowcol = TRUE, res = TRUE)) {
  print("Depth and SST match in CRS, extent, and resolution")
}
```


### Find Suitable Locations for Oysters

```{r}
# Reclassifying SST and depth into suitable locations for oysters

# Reclassify SST by making matrix
rcl_sst_oyster <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, 11, 0,
    11, 30, 1, 
    30, Inf, 0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply it to raster layer
sst_zones_oyster <- classify(avg_sst_C, rcl = rcl_sst_oyster)


# Reclassify depth by making matrix
rcl_depth_oyster <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, -70, 0,
    -70, 0, 1,
    0, Inf, 0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply it to raster layer
depth_zones_oyster <- classify(depth_resample, rcl = rcl_depth_oyster)
```


### Find Suitable Locations for Red Abalone

```{r}
# Reclassifying SST and depth into suitable locations for red abalone

# Reclassify SST by making matrix
rcl_sst_abalone <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, 8, 0,
    8, 18, 1, 
    18, Inf, 0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply it to raster layer
sst_zones_abalone <- classify(avg_sst_C, rcl = rcl_sst_abalone)


# Reclassify depth by making matrix
rcl_depth_abalone <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, -24, 0,
    -24, 0, 1,
    0, Inf, 0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply it to raster layer
depth_zones_abalone <- classify(depth_resample, rcl = rcl_depth_abalone)
```


### Map Suitable Areas

```{r}

# Find areas that satisfy both SST and depth
oyster_zone <- c(depth_zones_oyster, sst_zones_oyster)
oyster_suitable_zones <- lapp(oyster_zone, fun = function(sst, depth) {
    sst*depth})
```


### Determine suitable EEZ

```{r}

# Convert sf object to terra vector for rasterizing
EEZ_vector <- vect(EEZ)

# Rastertize EEZ
EEZ_raster <- rasterize(EEZ_vector, oyster_suitable_zones, field = 'rgn_id')

# Calculating area of each cell
cell_area <- cellSize(oyster_suitable_zones, unit = "km", mask = TRUE)

# Only the cells assigned to 1 
suitable_area <- mask(cell_area, oyster_suitable_zones, maskvalues = 0)

# Select raster cells that fall in EEZ regions
suitable_area_eez <- zonal(
    suitable_area,
    EEZ_raster, 
    fun = "sum",
    na.rm = TRUE
)
```

```{r}

# Convert into DataFrame
suitability_df <- as_tibble(suitable_area_eez) |> 
    rename(suitable_area_km2 = area) # rename column name

# Join suitable areas to EEZ polygons
EEZ_map <- left_join(EEZ, suitability_df)
```

### Create map of suitable EEZ regions

```{r}
#| warning: false

# Make a map of West Coast EEZ's 
tm_shape(EEZ_map) +

# Customize legend
  tm_fill(
    fill = "suitable_area_km2",
    fill.legend = tm_legend("Suitable Area (km²)"),
    fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous()) +

# Customize border of polygons
  tm_borders(lwd = 0.5) +

# Add a scalebar
  tm_scalebar(size = 0.3, 
  position = c("left", "bottom")) +

# Add a compass
  tm_compass(position = c("right", "top")) +

# Add a title
  tm_title("Suitable Oyster Habitat by EEZ", fontface = "bold")
```
